description: Types inferred from the root reducer and the configured store; never written by hand.
Lets a slice respond to actions defined elsewhere, via `builder.addCase(actionCreator, reducer)`.
Memoized selector from Reselect: recomputes only when its input selectors return new references.
A plain lookup such as `(state) => state.orders.items`, used as an input to `createSelector`.
Initial state passed to `configureStore`, used to seed stores in tests, stories and SSR.
